card.fact_statement: The partial articulated skeleton of Ardetosaurus was discovered at the Howe-Stephens Quarry.
card.source_span: In 1989, Hans-Jakob Siber and workers from the Aathal Dinosaur Museum revisited this location, finding another site later named the Howe-Stephens Quarry. Among the many associated dinosaur skeletons was a partial articulated skeleton of a diplodocid sauropod

card.fact_statement: The generic name Sidersaura translates to "star lizard".
card.source_span: Sidersaura (meaning "star lizard") is an extinct monotypic genus
